decisions.quote: We were unable to replicate the main effect of 5-HTTLPR or the 5-HTTLPR x Support interaction effect. In the Discussion, we examine the implications of our non-replication.
decisions.reason: The authors explicitly characterize the overall outcome as a 'non-replication', and under the title-focused and central-finding rules, neither the 5-HTTLPR main effect nor the central 5-HTTLPR x Parental Support interaction effect replicated, making the replication outcome 'failed' despite the baseline parental support and gender main effects.
